verdict.rationale: Rollbar ships an official MCP server (rollbar-docs-18, rollbar-probe-3) which is the standard mechanism for letting AI agents/assistants issue natural-language commands against Rollbar data, and the 'Resolve' AI agent (rollbar-docs-17) shows some agentic automation. However, there is no documentation of a native chat/NL interface, no detail on what commands the MCP server actually exposes (read vs. write actions), and no independent hands-on report of natural-language operation working end-to-end. Missing for 10: documented list of MCP tool commands/actions, evidence of write/action capability via NL (not just read), and third-party corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.
